activity_summary: You helped clear the winter house at the Cross Keys. Three apparel baskets and the property hamper went to the cart, and the inn's trestles stayed stacked. Garnish kept the books in his arms. The ostlers threw Sam his cues from the loft, having heard the comedy forty times. Heminges paid thirteen shillings and fourpence on the sill. The cart is eightpence, to be paid at the Theatre door. The host said he would look for you at Michaelmas, if my lord writes again.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept Nick with him behind the cart, and left the cues with the loft.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Counted thirteen and four onto the sill, and held the eightpence for the door.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Carried the books, and kept both keys of the chest.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Walked, and refused to be a basket.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Answered the loft, and was not allowed the tail of the cart.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: Shut the hamper and named the eightpenny fare up the street.

facets.activity: Cleared the winter house at the Cross Keys

speakers: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Thirteen shillings and fourpence. On the sill, and then in your hand.

quotes.speaker: (the host)
quotes.text: At Michaelmas, then, masters, if my lord writes again.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The books go in my arms. No other hand.
